meta.title: Crude receipt and tank changeover, CPSF-T-107/108/109 - SCTA
meta.goal: Receive crude oil into storage tank CPSF-T-107/108/109 and change over to the next tank
meta.site: Dragon Oil (Turkmenistan), crude oil tank farm terminal
meta.facility: Storage tanks CPSF-T-107, T-108, T-109 (8,425 m3 each)
meta.team: HF analyst (facilitator), process safety engineer, tank farm operations representative, instrument engineer (TBC)
meta.interviewees: TO BE CONFIRMED: control room operator and tank farm field operator walk-through not yet done. Desk study from the P&ID only.
meta.preconditions:
Plant state:
Receiving tank in service, not under maintenance
VRU CPSF-23-X-011 A/B available
Fuel gas blanketing available
Hot oil heating available

Equipment:
DCS with LIA/PIA/TIA for each tank
HS-10x-1/-2 for inlet and outlet SDVs
Radio link to degassing boot / metering operator

Personnel:
Control Room Operator (CRO)
Field Operator (FO)
Shift Supervisor (SS)
Degassing boot / metering operator (UO)
meta.notes:
Source: redrawn P&ID CPSF-PR-PID-1-0001-25-00 Rev X1 (Storage tanks CPSF-T-107/108/109), notes 1-17 and alarm/trip table. No operating procedure was supplied, so the "work as imagined" map is the design intent read from the P&ID, and the "work as done" map is an unverified DRAFT copy. All PIF ratings are PROVISIONAL from desk review and must be confirmed with the crew at a walk-through before the study is relied on.

Safety-critical task screening for this P&ID (this study covers task 1):
1. Crude receipt into a tank and changeover (THIS STUDY) - overfill / vapour cloud, Possible MAH. LSHH-10x alarms only; no automatic inlet closure shown.
2. Tank dewatering via N3 / N4 to sewage and dewatering pumps CPSF-P-127 - drain left open, crude to sewage. High. Recommended next study.
3. Inter-tank transfer with P-013A/B/C (Note 9, max 495 m3/h; Note 10 VRU limit) - overfill of receiving tank, VRU overload. High.
4. Hot oil heating coil start-up and isolation (ESDV-414x, XV-413x, GV-41xx) - coil leak, overheating; SIL 2 TSHH exists. Medium.
5. PVRV changeover / maintenance (LO/LC BFVs, spare PVRV) - tank isolated from relief. High (low frequency).
6. Fuel gas blanketing PCV bypass operation (GLV-4133/4135/4137) - overpressure / air ingress. Medium.

np6za6gntf1.label: Receive crude oil into storage tank CPSF-T-107/108/109 and change over to the next tank

plan.text: Do 1.1-1.6 in any order. All must be complete before 2.

nv02q4s3tf1.label: Read the receiving tank level on LIA-10x-1 and LIA-10x-2 and confirm ullage for the planned receipt
nv02q4s3tf1.warnings: LIT-10x-1 (roof N17) and LIT-10x-2 (shell N9) must agree
nv02q4s3tf1.riskReason: Wrong or stale ullage leads directly to overfill of a full tank: crude spill to bund and vapour cloud (Possible MAH).

n7ragsxqtf1.label: Confirm VRU CPSF-23-X-011 A/B is running and no inter-tank transfer is in progress (Note 10)
n7ragsxqtf1.riskReason: VRU is sized for filling at 500 m3/h only. Filling during inter-tank transfer overloads the VRU: tank pressure rises, PVRVs lift and vent crude vapour to atmosphere.

npxyb7gdtf1.label: Confirm vapour path to VRU (BFV-4135/4138/4139) and PVRV isolation BFVs A/B/C are locked open, spare S locked closed
npxyb7gdtf1.warnings: Roof access: work at height and H2S/hydrocarbon vapour
npxyb7gdtf1.riskReason: A closed vapour or PVRV isolation valve leaves the tank unprotected: roof overpressure on filling or vacuum collapse on emptying.

n7jkcmo5tf1.label: Confirm fuel gas blanketing PV-41xx is in service on PIC-41xx and bypass GLV is closed
n7jkcmo5tf1.riskReason: Bypass left open over-pressurises the vapour space with fuel gas; PV out of service lets air in (flammable atmosphere).

ntv4r4rvtf1.label: Confirm tank outlet SDV-10x-2, N3 dewatering valve and N4 drain to sewage are closed
ntv4r4rvtf1.riskReason: An open outlet or drain sends crude to the export header or to the sewage system during receipt: loss of containment outside the bund.

ncu453cutf1.label: Confirm oil temperature on TIT-41xx is within 35-40 degC and hot oil ESDV is available

na1ufoxhtf1.label: Select the receiving tank and agree it with the shift supervisor
na1ufoxhtf1.riskReason: Three identical tanks: selecting the wrong tank sends crude into a tank that may already be full (overfill, Possible MAH).

nttx5qrhtf1.label: Open inlet SDV-10x-1 of the selected tank from HS-10x-1
nttx5qrhtf1.riskReason: Right action on the wrong tank SDV opens the wrong tank to receipt.

n9l4ygqntf1.label: Confirm SDV-10x-1 shows open and the inlet SDVs of the other two tanks show closed
n9l4ygqntf1.riskReason: Two tanks open together splits the flow; the expected level rise is not seen in either.

nqpdbysftf1.label: Tell the degassing boot / metering operator which tank is lined up and the maximum receipt rate
nqpdbysftf1.riskReason: Wrong tank or rate passed upstream; receipt starts before line-up is complete.

plan.text: Do 3.1, then 3.2 continuously. Do 3.3-3.5 when the alarm occurs.

noxhnb9atf1.label: Confirm the level of the selected tank is rising on LIT-10x-1 and LIT-10x-2 within 15 minutes of start
noxhnb9atf1.riskReason: First and best chance to detect wrong tank, passing SDV or crude going elsewhere (sewage, other tank).

n2ok4x42tf1.label: Monitor level, receipt rate (max 500 m3/h) and tank pressure PIT-41xx and VRU line pressure PIT-415x through the receipt
n2ok4x42tf1.riskReason: Overfill or overpressure goes undetected if monitoring lapses; receipts run for many hours across shifts.

nermub1xtf1.label: On LIA-10x high alarm, prepare the changeover to the next tank
nermub1xtf1.riskReason: Late preparation leaves too little time before high-high level.

nxdhmny6tf1.label: On LSHH-10x / LA HH, stop the receipt immediately: close SDV-10x-1 (or divert) and tell the upstream operator
nxdhmny6tf1.warnings: Local close push-buttons are outside the bund wall (Note 3)
nxdhmny6tf1.riskReason: Last operator barrier before overfill. LSHH-10x alarms only (LA HH); no automatic trip is shown on the P&ID.

nhlc1rljtf1.label: On high tank pressure (PIT-41xx H 0.005 barg) or VRU trip, reduce or stop the receipt
nhlc1rljtf1.riskReason: Continued filling against a lost VRU vents crude vapour through the PVRVs.

n6wqr5kxtf1.label: Change over to the next tank

plan.text: Do when the receiving tank reaches its planned fill level or LIA-10x high. Do 4.1-4.4 in sequence: open the next tank BEFORE closing the full tank.

n2ar1bx3tf1.label: Confirm the next tank has ullage and is prepared (steps 1.1-1.5 done for that tank)
n2ar1bx3tf1.riskReason: Changing over into an unprepared or full tank repeats the overfill scenario.

nz6sw33utf1.label: Open inlet SDV of the next tank
nz6sw33utf1.riskReason: Opening the wrong SDV, or opening after the full tank is closed, blocks the receipt line.

n1n6yz6otf1.label: Close inlet SDV-10x-1 of the full tank
n1n6yz6otf1.riskReason: Closing first dead-heads the receipt line (upstream overpressure); closing the wrong tank SDV keeps filling the full tank.

nx36gci6tf1.label: Confirm the full tank level is steady and the next tank level is rising
nx36gci6tf1.riskReason: Only check that the changeover actually happened.

nftx7r0ntf1.label: Record tank, start time, levels and changeover in the shift log

nmndgrs8tf1.label: Hand over the receipt status (tank, level, time to high level, alarms) at shift change
nmndgrs8tf1.riskReason: Receipts run across shift change; an incomplete handover is a known precursor of overfill.
